g.text: Chunk - OCR Fusion, Hallucination Filtering, Normalization & RAG Chunking
This diagram shows the downstream Chunk project's workflow.
It is provided here to illustrate how Prepare-Doc quality
metrics feed trust scoring for RAG chunking decisions.
Chunk internals are NOT part of the Prepare-Doc codebase.
- Trust signal: page_IQA_risk from pre_ocr_risk field
